# BASE-ics 1
Check out this cool code I found!
I wonder what it means

```
01100111 01101001 01100111 01100101 01101101 01111011 01100101 01101110 01100011 00110000 01100100 00110001 01101110 01100111 01011111 00110001 01110011 01011111 01101110 00110000 01110100 01011111 00110011 01101110 01100011 01110010 01111001 01110000 01110100 00110001 00110000 01101110 01111101
```

## Solution
This is binary. Use [CyberChef](https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/#recipe=From_Binary('Space',8)&) to get the flag.
Flag: `gigem{enc0d1ng_1s_n0t_3ncrypt10n}`
